description: This file defines a caching system for a language model project, including cache classes, cache management functions, and external integrations for various cache backends such as Redis, S3, GCS, Azure Blob, Disk, and in-memory caches. It handles cache key generation, retrieval, insertion, and async operations, supporting different caching modes and types.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: A central class managing different cache backends and operations such as get, set, and delete, supporting multiple cache types and asynchronous operations.

methods.name: str get_cache_key(self, **kwargs)
methods.description: Generates a unique cache key based on input parameters, including optional preset keys and hashing.

methods.name: add_cache(self, result, **kwargs)
methods.description: Adds a result to the cache with timestamping and optional TTL.

methods.name: async_add_cache( self, result, dynamic_cache_object: Optional[BaseCache] = None, **kwargs )
methods.description: Asynchronous version of add_cache supporting bulk cache insertion.

methods.name: get_cache(self, dynamic_cache_object: Optional[BaseCache] = None, **kwargs)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached result based on generated cache key, considering cache age constraints.

methods.name: CachedEmbedding _convert_to_cached_embedding( self, embedding_response: Any, model: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Converts various embedding response formats into a standard CachedEmbedding dictionary.

methods.name: Tuple[str,dict,dict] add_embedding_response_to_cache( self, result: EmbeddingResponse, input: str, kwargs: dict, idx_in_result_data: int = 0, )
methods.description: Adds embedding responses to the cache, transforming response data into a standard format.

methods.name: async_add_cache_pipeline( self, result, dynamic_cache_object: Optional[BaseCache] = None, **kwargs )
methods.description: Bulk async cache insertion, optimized for multiple responses.

methods.name: should_use_cache(self, **kwargs)
methods.description: Determines if caching should be used based on mode and user settings.

methods.name: ping(self)
methods.description: Checks the health/status of the cache backend.

methods.name: disconnect(self)
methods.description: Closes connections to the cache backend.

methods.name: bool _supports_async(self)
methods.description: Checks whether the cache backend supports asynchronous operations.
